findings.claim: The 2090 cm-1 band is due to CO bound atop a single Pt atom (carbon-down).
The 1850 cm-1 band is due to bridge-bonded CO.
Atop CO is the majority species at 0.25 ML; bridge CO is a minority species.

structural_constraints.value: C-bound CO on a top site
structural_constraints.derivation: Authors' assignment of the strong 2090 cm-1 C-O stretching band to CO bound atop a single Pt atom (carbon-down).

structural_constraints.value: a minority of CO bridging two Pt atoms
structural_constraints.derivation: Authors' assignment of the weak 1850 cm-1 C-O stretching band to bridge-bonded CO.
Authors' assignments of the C-O stretching bands: 2090 cm-1 to carbon-down CO atop a Pt atom, 1850 cm-1 to bridge-bonded CO.

structural_constraints.property: majority CO adsorption site at 0.25 ML
structural_constraints.derivation: The strong 2090 cm-1 band is assigned to atop CO. Cross-technique support: the main C 1s XPS component at 286.8 eV is assigned to atop CO (XPS:O1, evidence E5).

caveats: Measured by IRRAS (infrared reflection-absorption spectroscopy), filed under the canonical technique FTIR.
The paper does not provide the CO tilt angle.
The paper does not provide the relative populations of atop and bridge CO.
